manuscriptTitle: From Language Priors towards Physical AGI

groups.title: Language priors
groups.question: What knowledge does the agent bring?
groups.description: Semantic and procedural structure before physical interaction.

groups.title: Grounded state
groups.question: What is happening here, now?
groups.description: Objects, geometry, affordances, and changes that matter for action.

groups.title: Action & skills
groups.question: What can the agent actually do?
groups.description: Interfaces that turn intentions into executable behavior.

groups.title: Predictive world models
groups.question: What happens if the agent acts?
groups.description: Consequences, uncertainty, and predictions useful for decisions.

groups.title: Integrated agency
groups.question: How does the loop stay grounded?
groups.description: Planning, execution, feedback, and recovery within one system.

groups.title: Generality & evaluation
groups.question: What transfers beyond training?
groups.description: Novelty, bounded adaptation, retention, and embodiment transfer.

benchmarks.name: LIBERO
benchmarks.caveat: Original four-suite accounting; later subset conventions differ.

benchmarks.name: BEHAVIOR-1K
benchmarks.detail: Logical everyday-activity definitions grounded in realistic simulation.
benchmarks.caveat: Definitions are not sampled episodes or experimentally solved activities.

benchmarks.name: RoboCasa
benchmarks.detail: 25 atomic + 75 composite tasks; scenes combine floor plans and styles.
benchmarks.caveat: Original 2024 release, not the later RoboCasa365 leaderboard.

benchmarks.name: EmbodiedBench
benchmarks.detail: 6 capability subsets across EB-ALFRED, EB-Habitat, EB-Navigation, and EB-Manipulation.
benchmarks.caveat: Six refers to capability subsets, not environments; instances are not task families.
